about: Google Cloud Text-to-Speech voices for the prologue's speakers (tools/voice/google_tts.py). Cast by the user by ear from the sampler on 2026-11-22: Ike Sadachbia (third candidate), Bob Alnilam (second), L-7 Iapetus (second). Per speaker the voice in each language, its speakingRate, the pause in seconds that a '…' inside a line becomes, optionally the longest silence between sentences ('gap', Ike: Sadachbia's German otherwise waits up to 1.7 s), and the candidates the sampler (google_tts.py --sampler) plays. Speakers not listed here keep their Windows SAPI stand-in (placeholders.py). A speaker's preset variants (bob-radio) use the speaker's voice. A recording in tools/voice/recordings always wins.
